mapper.select: SELECT id, space_id, folder_id, name, file_type, file_size, file_path, description, upload_by, deleted, parse_status, chunk_count, parse_error, parsed_at, parse_version, parse_started_at, created_at, updated_at FROM document WHERE deleted = 1 AND space_id = #{spaceId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, space_id, folder_id, name, file_type, file_size, file_path, description, upload_by, deleted, parse_status, chunk_count, parse_error, parsed_at, parse_version, parse_started_at, created_at, updated_at FROM document WHERE id = #{documentId} AND deleted = 1

SELECT d.id, d.space_id, d.folder_id, d.name, d.file_type, d.file_size, d.file_path, d.description, d.upload_by, d.deleted, d.parse_status, d.chunk_count, d.parse_error, d.parsed_at, d.parse_version, d.parse_started_at, d.created_at, d.updated_at FROM document d JOIN document_tag dt ON d.id = dt.document_id WHERE d.space_id = #{spaceId} AND d.deleted = 0 AND dt.tag_id = #{tagId} ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC, d.id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT d.id, d.space_id, d.folder_id, d.name, d.file_type, d.file_size, d.file_path, d.description, d.upload_by, d.deleted, d.parse_status, d.chunk_count, d.parse_error, d.parsed_at, d.parse_version, d.parse_started_at, d.created_at, d.updated_at FROM document d LEFT JOIN document_tag dt ON d.id = dt.document_id LEFT JOIN tag t ON dt.tag_id = t.id WHERE d.space_id = #{spaceId} AND d.deleted = 0 AND ( /*匹配 name description tags*/ MATCH(d.name) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE)/*名称*/ OR MATCH(d.description) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE)/*描述*/ OR t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') /*标签*/ ) ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC, d.id DESC

SELECT d.id AS document_id, d.space_id AS space_id, s.name AS space_name, d.name AS name, d.file_type AS file_type, d.file_size AS file_size, d.updated_at AS updated_at FROM document d INNER JOIN space s ON s.id = d.space_id AND s.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN space_member sm ON sm.space_id = d.space_id AND sm.user_id = #{userId} WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.id IN
#{documentId}

choose.when: SELECT id FROM space WHERE id = #{spaceId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
choose.otherwise: SELECT id FROM folder WHERE id = #{folderId} AND space_id = #{spaceId} FOR UPDATE
